title: Withings Vision Score Trend
dataSources: Open Dental appointments (`opendental:appointment`), Zocdoc bookings (`zocdoc:booking`), vision prescriptions (`vision:prescription`), dental hygiene visits (`dental:hygiene`), and Withings eye-health checks (`withings:eye`).
app: Open Dental appointment exports, Zocdoc booking webhooks, vision prescription sidecars, dental hygiene visit logs, and Withings Vision eye-health readings streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=withings:eye eye_score=*
| timechart span=1mon avg(eye_score) as avg_score, min(eye_score) as worst_score
| fillnull value=0
description: Trends monthly average and worst Withings Vision eye-health scores from home screening exports.
value: Gradual vision-score drift is easier to act on when you see it as a trend instead of one isolated reading.
implementation: Export Withings Vision results with `eye_score` and schedule a monthly review against your optometrist baseline.
visualization: Line chart of monthly average and worst eye score.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks whether your at-home eye scores are slowly getting better or worse over the months.
